error[ZBX-E0302]: the user bus refused to authenticate this user
  while  starting container web-1
  while  starting the container's scope zbx-web-1.scope
  cause  authenticating to the user bus failed at the auth step
  cause  the bus answered 'REJECTED EXTERNAL' to EXTERNAL authentication as this
         user: the socket may belong to another user (an inherited
         DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS after su or sudo)
  scope  zbx-web-1.scope
  name   web-1
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   start_scope (6 of 52)
  fix    see which bus this process uses:   echo $DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS
         or log in again through a systemd session
  more   zbx explain E0302
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0302.html
